meta.title: What If Friction Disappeared for 5 Seconds? v2 (TikTok)

captions.text: What if friction disappeared for 5 seconds?
Friction is holding all of this together.
Every grip on Earth just let go.
Roof tiles slide off. Scaffolding drops.
Scaffold clamps hold on by friction alone.
Cars can't stop. People can't stand.
Steel towers sway as bolted joints slip.
And the ground? Soil is grains held together by friction.
Hillsides start to flow like liquid.
Whole slopes slide, carrying houses and trees with them.
But it goes deeper than the soil.
Tectonic plates are locked together by friction.
Now every fault on Earth can slip at once.
Everything stops… wherever it happens to be.
Would you survive 5 seconds without friction?
